summary_en: Isuzu Motors authorized acquisition of up to 35 million shares (5.1% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 50 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to March 31, 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Isuzu Motors' board of directors resolved to acquire up to 35 million shares of its own common stock with a maximum total expenditure of 50 billion yen during the period from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The shares will be acquired through market purchases conducted via ToSTNeT-3 (Tokyo Stock Exchange's off-auction self-stock trading system) and through market purchases under a discretionary trading agreement. The 35 million shares represent 5.1% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, calculated against a denominator of 687,306,070 shares. All acquired shares will subsequently be cancelled.

The company stated that the purpose of this buyback is to maintain an appropriate level of own capital and to achieve further improvement in capital efficiency. The acquisition is consistent with the company's basic policy of implementing shareholder returns based on profits each period while maintaining financial soundness and securing funds for growth investments. The board delegated detailed implementation decisions to the Chief Financial Officer. There is no ceiling price specified for the acquisition; the company noted that depending on market conditions, part or all of the acquisition may not be executed.
